Last release: @thoth-agents/pi-todo@0.4.5
Target ref: @thoth-agents/pi-todo@0.5.0

## Core
### Improvements

- `dcdf1b2` feat(pi-todo): cap completed todos in compact views
- `f956de7` feat(pi-todo): group, order and archive todos in compact views
- `30fdcdf` feat(pi-core): one compact count standard for sidebar and work panel

### Bugfixes

- `2f344d2` fix(pi-todo): reject malformed replay snapshots whole
- `9e347f4` fix(pi-core): show todo pending counts with the row pending glyph
- `ad55204` fix(pi-todo): soften pending todo rows to the muted role

## CLI & Config
### Improvements

- `4ff8193` feat(pi): adopt Pi 1.5.0 injected key hints and cost provenance
- `aa84384` feat(pi)!: require Pi 1.5.0 across all Pi packages

## Docs & CI
### Bugfixes

- `421e51c` fix(pi-packages): track local versions in package changelogs
